en.headline: Two men arrested over red-paint attacks on two restaurants
en.dek: Police said the men, aged 33 and 49, were detained on suspicion of criminal damage after paint was thrown at two outlets of the same dining group.
body: Police on Thursday arrested two local men, aged 33 and 49, on suspicion of criminal damage after two restaurants belonging to the same dining group were splashed with red paint earlier this month.

Officers from the West Kowloon Regional Anti-Triad Unit said they had reviewed extensive closed-circuit television footage before making the arrests in Yau Ma Tei and Mong Kok. Clothing believed to have been worn at the time of the incidents was seized. Both men were being held for enquiries.

Staff at a restaurant in East Kowloon Plaza on Shing Yip Street, Kwun Tong, reported on the morning of 11 September that red paint covered a signboard, wall and floor over an area of about three metres by three metres. About half an hour later, staff at another restaurant on Baker Street in Hung Hom reported similar damage to a doorway, signboard, wall and floor. Police classified both cases as criminal damage.

The operator of the two restaurants told Hong Kong 01 it had no recent dispute with anyone and was not in debt. Police reminded the public that criminal damage carries a maximum sentence of 10 years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 觀塘紅磬兩酒樓遭淋紅油 警拘兩男涉刑毀
zh.dek: 西九龍總區反三合會行動組周四在油麻地及旺角拘捕33歲及49歲男子，涉嫌早前向同一集團兩間酒樓淋澔紅油。
body: 警方周四拘捕兩名分別33歲及49歲的本地男子，涉嫌刑事毀壞。他們被指與本月早前觀塘及紅磬兩間屬同一飲食集團的酒樓遭淋紅油有關。
西九龍總區反三合會行動組表示，經深入調查並翻查大量閉路電視片段後，分別在油麻地及旺角拘捕兩人，行動中檢獲案發時被捕人身穿的衣物。兩人現正被扣留調查。
本月11日早上約6時39分，觀塘成業街東廣場一間酒樓職員報案，指招牌燈箱、壁壁及地面被淋紅油，面積約3米乘3米。約半小時後，紅磬必嘉街另一間酒樓職員亦報稱大門、招牌、壁壁及地面被淋油。警方將兩案列作刑事毀壞處理。
涉事集團回覆查詢時表示，近日沒有與任何人士結怨，亦無涉及欠債。警方提醒，根據《刑事罪行條例》，刑事毀壞最高可判監禁十年。
